name: Firecrawl
author: Mathi5
short_desc: Web scraping API turning any site into clean LLM-ready markdown.
description: Self-hosted Firecrawl: scrape, crawl and search any website and get clean markdown ready for LLM consumption. Includes the Playwright microservice for JS-heavy pages. API compatible with the Firecrawl SDKs (v2).

form_fields.label: API key (NOT enforced server-side in self-hosted mode — see description; network protection is up to you)
Bull board admin key (secret path segment)
LLM base URL (OpenAI-compatible)
form_fields.hint: Optional. Leave empty to disable LLM features. Example: http://host.docker.internal:11434/v1

form_fields.label: LLM model name
form_fields.hint: Only used when an LLM base URL is set

form_fields.label: SearXNG endpoint URL
form_fields.hint: Optional. SearXNG URL reachable from this app, e.g. http://searxng:8080 (container name). Leave empty to disable search.

form_fields.label: Max CPU usage ratio for workers (0-1)
form_fields.hint: Workers refuse new jobs above this host CPU load. Raise to 1 if scrapes stay queued on a busy host. Default: 0.8

form_fields.label: Max RAM usage ratio for workers (0-1)
form_fields.hint: Workers refuse new jobs above this host RAM usage. Raise to 1 if scrapes stay queued on a busy host. Default: 0.8
